messages.content: Who won the chess tournament in 2015?

function.name: game_board_analyser
function.description: Analyse a given board position of the game and suggest the optimal next move Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

game.description: The name of the game. In this case, chess

player.description: The current player whose turn is to move.

position.description: The current state of the board in FEN (Forsyth–Edwards Notation) format.

difficulty.description: The level of difficulty for the suggested move. Options include 'easy', 'medium', 'hard'.

message.content: In 2015, Magnus Carlsen successfully defended his title at the World Chess Championship, defeating Sergey Karjakin in the match held in New York City.
message.reasoning:
The user asks: "Who won the chess tournament in 2015?" This is ambiguous: which chess tournament? Could refer to World Chess Championship 2015? That was held in 2015 between Magnus Carlsen and Sergey Karjakin; Carlsen defended his title. So answer: Magnus Carlsen.

But maybe they refer to some other tournament like the 2015 World Cup? But likely it's the World Chess Championship. Provide answer accordingly.
